all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] The skew test skips silently when the tag is missing, and the new reader's newer_writer path is covered only by a unit test. A tag-less checkout drops the pin; a wiring regression of ReaderVersion on the CLI path would not be caught end to end.

[ADVISORY] Init does not take the lock when a workflow's initial node is agent-edit, and a run already in fix at upgrade holds no lock. Latent (no shipped workflow starts in agent-edit); an upgrade window is unguarded.

[ADVISORY] fresh() has no lower bound, so a hold whose since is in the future (a backward clock step, a hand-edited lock) stays fresh for the whole skew plus Grace. A dead hold cannot be taken over until the clock passes since+Grace; a far-future since locks the worktree until the file is removed by hand. Cannot steal the lock.

rejected.desc: [BUG] The edit lock is acquired before the transition into agent-edit is appended, but holderLive counts a holder live only once its folded run is in agent-edit, so between Acquire and the append a fresh hold reads as stale; Fork likewise acquires for a child before Store.Create (the child is not found, so not live). Two runs entering fix in one worktree at the same moment can both succeed: B judges A's fresh hold stale, takes it over, and both edit one tree — the corruption #180 exists to prevent.
[ADVISORY] A malformed or empty edit.lock blocks every Acquire until removed by hand. Recoverable (the error says to remove it); needs a crash mid-write that writeAtomic makes unlikely.

[ADVISORY] holderLive treats any error other than run-not-found as live (a newer-writer holder, a corrupt log), and a crashed host leaves its run in agent-edit indefinitely. Fix loops in that worktree stay blocked until the run is closed (#179) or the lock removed; fail-safe.

[ADVISORY] AC-5.1's 'no worktree's gate is affected' is not exercised by a gate run, and AC-5.3 black-box covers only a holder that no longer exists. Cross-worktree gate-state leaks or holderLive wiring drift would not be caught by the shell suite.

fix@0.summary: Edit-lock holds are live for a grace after they are taken (closing the acquire-before-append window); a run already in its fix node takes the lock at its next advance (pre-0.14 in-flight runs, workflows starting in a fix); the skew test fails in CI without the previous tag and proves the newer-writer refusal end to end.

fix@1.summary: A hold dated beyond Grace into the future is not fresh, so its run decides and a dead hold can be taken over.
